meta.title: Soy Resinator · Full-size 3D printed replicas
meta.description: Full-size sci-fi replicas, 3D printed in Spain and shipped as an unpainted kit. Order without an account.
hero.kicker: Forged layer by layer in Spain
hero.titulo: Full-size replicas for your wall, your shelf, your next convention
hero.texto: Every piece is 3D printed to order and shipped as a kit, unpainted. The color comes from the filament, so you pick it and we print it.
info.kit_texto: It arrives disassembled, like flat-pack furniture. Put it together in an evening.
info.color_texto: Choose the color of the key parts from the filament we have on the shelf right now.
info.plazo_texto: We start printing when your payment arrives. Ideal shipping time: about 3 weeks from then.
envio.label: Ship to
envio.otro_texto: We don't list your country yet. Write to us and we'll quote you shipping.
precio.aduanas: Customs in your country may charge import taxes on arrival.
precio.sin_pais: VAT included in the EU · final price outside the EU
cat.error_carga: We couldn't load the catalog. Refresh the page or try again in a minute.
cerrado.texto: Right now the forge is full. Follow us on Instagram to know when we open the next window.
colores.nota_offline: More colors available: tell us which one you want in the notes.
pie.texto: Display replicas, 3D printed in Spain. No firing capability.
pie.aviso: Independent original work, not affiliated with or endorsed by any game publisher.
ped.vacio: Your order is empty. Pick a replica in the armory to get started.
ped.montaje_ayuda: We assemble it for you before shipping. Only for orders shipped within Spain.
ped.montaje_quitado: The assembly service is not available, so we've taken it off your order.
ped.colores_cambiados: Some colors you had picked have run out. We've switched them to the standard color: {lista}.
ped.producto_retirado: A replica in your saved order is no longer available, so we've removed it.
pago.completo_ayuda: You pay the whole amount at once.
pago.nada_ahora: We don't charge anything here. We'll email you the payment details.
pago.metodo_sin_pais: Bank transfer in Spain and the EU, PayPal everywhere else.
pago.inicio: Printing starts when we receive your payment (or the first payment, if you pay in two parts).
res.envio_pendiente: Choose your country to calculate shipping
res.plazo: Ships about {n} days after your payment (around {fecha} if you pay today).
res.plazo_fijo: The date is set when your payment arrives.
res.plazo_defecto: Ships about 3 weeks after your payment.
res.acepto_privacidad: I have read and accept the {enlace}
err.pais: Choose a country from the list.
err.condiciones: You need to accept the terms of sale.
err.privacidad: You need to accept the privacy policy.
err.fallo_titulo: Your order hasn't been sent yet
err.fallo_texto: Nothing is lost: it's still saved in this browser. Try again in a few minutes, or copy the summary and send it to us by email or Instagram.
err.servidor: Something went wrong on our side.
err.pedidos_cerrados: The forge is full right now, so we can't take new orders.
err.datos_invalidos: Some details aren't valid. Check the form.
err.color_no_disponible: One of the colors just ran out. We've updated your order: check it and send it again.
err.producto_no_existe: One of the replicas is no longer available.
err.montaje_no_disponible: The assembly service is not available.
err.demasiados_pedidos: You've sent too many orders today. Write to us and we'll sort it out.
conf.texto: Your replica is in the queue. Keep this ID: you'll need it to track your order.
conf.email: We've also sent it to {email}. If you can't find it, check your spam folder.
conf.paso1: Within 24 hours we'll email you the payment details.
conf.paso2: We start printing when your payment arrives (or the first payment, if you pay in two parts).
conf.paso3: Ideal shipping time: 3 weeks from that payment.
mail.intro: Your order has reached the forge. Here's your ID and everything that happens next.
mail.dudas: Any questions? Just reply to this email.
err.no_encontrado: We couldn't find an order with that ID and email. Check both and try again.
seg.intro: Enter your order ID and the email you ordered with.
seg.fecha_pendiente: The date is set when your payment arrives.
seg.sin_api: Order tracking isn't available right now. Write to us and we'll tell you how it's going.
seg.ayuda: Can't find your ID? It's in the confirmation email. You can also write to us.
seg.id_invalido: The ID is SR- followed by 6 letters and numbers.
seg.cancelado_texto: This order has been cancelled. If you think it's a mistake, write to us.
